## Phase 0 — context load

Contract read in full. Load list honoured: canonical spec §3 + §56.6
(SIG-REL-007 verbatim — the check table and "any failure or skip blocks
promotion") + §40 (page-type/zero-JS) + §56.10 (scrub + disclosure wording);
G3 §3.2–3.3 (descriptor + clock rules), §5.3 (containment), §5.4
(allow-list), §5.5 (the V-table: S = V1–V5+V11–V13, P = V1-sample-200/V3/V4/
V5-sample/V13), §6.2 (release.json/latest.json field sets);
`release_publish_verify.py` / `composed_verify.py` / `journey_verify.py`
(the landed `_check`/JSON-result idioms — reused, never forked);
`ops/public_routes.toml` + `ops/cadence.toml`; the dep tickets P35.13 /
P35.53 / P34.34b / P35.31.

Key facts recorded before implementation:

- `exports.release.validate_release()` is the local integrity authority — V1
  consumes its `complete` state rather than re-deriving it.
- `exports.release_identity` owns the descriptor-v2 validation, the §3.3
  clock rules, and the promotion refusals; V2 composes those and probes repo
  facts (pushed/clean) — when they can't be established the leg is `skip`,
  which blocks (SIG-ENG-042).
- `ops.publish` owns the allow-list diff + public content assertions V3
  applies; `policy.transparency.find_secrets()` is V12's scanner —
  fail-closed, no waiver.
- `release_publish_verify.api_parity_check` stays P35.57's — not duplicated.
- The serving contract (`ops/web/nginx.conf`): `v/<latest>` is the site root;
  `/r/` `/s/` `/releases/<pub>/` are gated by `promoted.map` (default 0,
  staging never gates); `/releases/`'s generated index set serves from
  `conf/<gen>`; `/entity/` stubs are mutable overlays under the latest view.
  The local `--tree` fetcher implements the same map verbatim and records
  `origin_kind: "tree"` — never a staging/public claim.

## Phase 1 — implementation

- **`ops/src/ops/release_verify.py`** (new, ~1,660 lines) — the suite.
  `FetchResult`/`HttpFetcher` (origin + optional `--origin-header` identity
  headers) / `TreeFetcher` (the §4.2 mapping over a built tree — the fixture
  posture) / `LocalOriginServer` (loopback HTTP for the axe leg).
  `VerifyContext` carries mode, work_dir, pub, fetcher, origin metadata,
  store, route config, budgets/disclosure paths, repo facts, axe runner and
  waiver inputs. `run_suite` executes the mode's check table, applies
  `apply_waivers` (Class-S only, named `V<n>=<readout-ref>` refs, V12 never
  waivable, ignored waivers recorded), and emits a `sig.release-verify/1`
  suite doc; `write_results` persists `<mode>-V<n>-<origin>.json` rows plus
  `suite-<mode>-<origin>.json` — append-only evidence, reruns write new
  files.
  - **V1** — `validate_release` complete + descriptor digest recomputes to
    the pub id + every <1 MiB manifest artifact fetched and sha256-matched;
    larger/record artifacts take a deterministic stratified 2 % sample
    (S mode), a 200-artifact cap in P mode. Unfetchable/mismatched → fail.
  - **V2** — descriptor v2 + `environment=production` + 40-hex pushed/clean
    commit + no `0.0.0` + §3.3 rules + label uniqueness +
    `as_of_world` > current latest's + emitted-surface date scan; repo or
    latest facts unevaluable → `skip` legs, never assumed.
  - **V3** — route-set equality with `public_routes.toml`, content
    assertions (curate banner, loopback form actions, `demo_*`,
    `presentation/`), denied-route probes 404 — `/releases/` excluded as
    pipeline-owned.
  - **V4** — every HTML page in the namespaces: exactly one `sig-release`
    meta + one `describedby` + one visible stamp block matching
    `release.json` (label/pub/short-pub/commit/as-of), `X-SIG-Release` on
    every response; P mode compares the header to `latest.json`.
  - **V5** — same-origin link crawl → 200 or declared 410 (P-mode caps at
    200 routes by sha256 order); §5.3 containment over `s/<pub>/` with the
    `/r/<pub>/`, `/releases/` and `rel="latest-version"` exceptions.
  - **V11** — zero `<script>` on content pages, `page-budgets.json`
    ceilings, and a real Playwright+axe scan
    (`web/scripts/axe_scan.mjs` — WCAG 2.x tag sets, critical `page-eval`
    findings on navigation/runner errors); a missing budgets file, runner,
    or browser is `skip`, and serious/critical violations fail.
  - **V12** — `find_secrets` over every publish-set file; one hit fails;
    evidence records file/line/detector class only — never the secret.
  - **V13** — descriptor disclosure ids exist, text digests recompute,
    required renderings present, the "API is live" line on stamped pages,
    eval-status wording never overclaims `evaluation.status`.
- **`ops/src/ops/release_pipeline.py`** — `verb_verify` keeps the bounded
  staged==built + integrity leg verbatim when `mode` is absent; with
  `--mode S|P` it builds the contexts (`_verify_suite_contexts` — HTTP
  origins with identity headers, the tree origin with the conf generation's
  overrides + promoted map), runs every suite, writes results, and
  `--apply` journals `verified` (S) / `verified-p` (P — never re-folds the
  lifecycle backwards) or `failed`; a blocked suite raises
  `PipelineError("verify-failed")`. No origin → every check `skip`s →
  blocked.
- **`ops/src/ops/cli.py`** — `--mode {S,P}`, `--origin` (repeatable),
  `--origin-header`, `--tree`, `--results-dir`, `--class
  {class_r,class_s}` (`dest=release_class`), `--waiver`, `--repo-root`,
  `--no-repo-probe`, `--repo-facts` — dispatch wires all of them.
- **`web/scripts/axe_scan.mjs`** (new) — the real runner: Chromium +
  `@axe-core/playwright`, one JSON document of per-path violations; a
  navigation/eval failure lands a critical `page-eval` violation rather
  than dropping the page. (Lives under `web/` where the deps resolve.)

## Phase 2 — tests

- `tests/ops/test_release_verify.py` (new, 24 tests) — the fixture
  `_build_candidate` builds a real v2 release tree + site trees + registry
  conf gens; the green S suite over the tree origin; JSON row shape;
  skip-blocks; waivers (Class-S only, V12 never); seeded defects — one per
  check: tampered artifact (V1), unpushed commit / non-production env (V2),
  unlisted + denied-answering routes (V3), missing stamp / wrong header
  (V4), containment escape / dead link (V5), script tag / oversized page /
  real axe violation (V11), planted secret (V12), unrendered disclosure
  (V13); verb-level journaling (`verified`, `failed`, bounded no-mode
  scope, tree-P promoted-map gating).
- `tests/e2e/test_release_verify_composed.py` (new, 3 tests, real Docker
  `release-serving` profile — `sig-e2e-verify` project) — S mode over
  `web-staging` green + per-check JSON files durable; seeded staged-byte
  tamper → V1 fail → `verify-failed` + journaled `failed`; P mode over
  `web` — promoted gate + headers verified, suite blocked **only** by the
  recorded `D-P35.56-1` catalog.jsonld gap (asserted as exactly
  `{404: ["/releases/catalog.jsonld"]}` — anything more is a real failure).

## Honesty notes

  is local fixture (`origin_kind: "tree"`) or composed-stack

  `/releases/catalog.jsonld` is linked by every stamped page yet the public
  deny gate 404s it. The suite reports it loudly; the fix belongs to the
